title: Ceramics Studio Access Membership
source_quote: We fire weekly in our three electric kilns, and bi-monthly in a down-draft gas kiln and a soda kiln. We also have a raku kiln accessible through workshops or rentals.
evidence_sentence: Members of the Ceramics Studio can access raku, gas, soda, and electric firings through the access membership program.
evidence_quote: We also have a raku kiln accessible through workshops or rentals.
summary: PCA&M offers ongoing membership access to a ceramics studio with electric, gas reduction, soda, and raku kilns. Members fire weekly in electric kilns and bi-monthly in gas and soda kilns; raku is available through workshops or rentals. Must complete at least one ceramics class before membership eligibility.
cost_text: 2-Shelf Access (3 Month) $400; 2-Shelf Access (12 Month) $1200; 1-Shelf Access (3 Month) $300; Firing-Only Access (3 Month) $150
how_to_join: Contact Studio Arts Manager Alex Watrous at awatrous@pghartsmedia.org or 412-361-0455 x 3; must complete at least one ceramics class before membership is granted
